description: The always-run spine: tests whose breakage can invalidate the meaning of every other test. Hand-curated on purpose. Unlike the subsystem taxonomy, completeness is NOT this list's contract - stability and breadth of fundamental mechanisms are. It must stay small enough that every ordinary change can afford it, so a test belongs here only if its failure would make other green results untrustworthy.

rationale.test-machinery: if the runner, the classifier or the change selector is wrong, every other result is meaningless - once ordinary development runs a SELECTED proof, the selector decides what every other green result covers, so its own contracts are unconditional
rationale.public-surface: package and API boundaries break consumers without breaking any subsystem test
rationale.core-mechanisms: storage, consensus, routing, bootstrap, query and service invocation underpin nearly every higher-level proof
rationale.identity-primitives: correlation and canonical encoding silently corrupt evidence everywhere when broken
